hero._note: Full-bleed dark bg, text at bottom-left. Floating typographic scatter elements at low opacity can be layered across the canvas using absolute positioning — adapted from ellipsus hero pattern.

gritme-feature._note: Left: text column, Right: product screenshot

photoGrid.description: Asymmetric two-column photo mosaic — left column 410px wide, right column 550px wide, staggered vertical offsets
photoGrid.gap: staggered — not a uniform gap system

fullBleed.description: Background layers, globe image, CTA section — span full 1440px+

manifesto-split._note: Large editorial text left ~60% width, decorative floating illustrations right — adapted to griting's dark/off-white alternating section rhythm

cta-asymmetric._note: Left: headline + CTA button, Right: large illustration element. Sits before footer on dark background.

version-cards._note: Three equal-width tall cards, may partially overflow section bottom as teaser reveal

visual.description: Full-width flex nav at 72px tall. Logo anchored left (~22px from edge), centered spacer, nav links pushed right. Three logical zones: logo | spacer | links+cta.

Full-bleed dark green (#003620) hero at 1420x980px. Single-column grid — headline and CTA buttons positioned at bottom-left, overlaying the full dark background. Optionally: floating low-opacity typographic scatter elements can be layered across the canvas as an ambient depth texture (adapted from ellipsus).
Four equal-width feature pillar cards displayed side by side at 1440px full-bleed.
1440px full-bleed dark background. Heading and subheading centered. Below: three equal-width cards (Businesses, Individuals, Community) in a 3-column grid.
Three GritMe sections each using a two-column split at ~1420px: 40% text column left, 60% product screenshot or feature cards right. Alternating background treatments between off-white and dark.
Two equal product cards (GritLab, GritHub) side by side.

Light background section. Large editorial display text left-aligned spanning ~60% of width. Right side holds floating decorative illustration elements — adapted from ellipsus manifesto pattern. Key phrases may use italic or accent color for emphasis. Hand-drawn annotation arrows are optional brand detail.
3-column equal-width grid on white background at 1440px. Cards vary in height for masonry-like visual rhythm.
Full-bleed dark section with centered heading and horizontal CTA button group. No column subdivisions.

Dark background transitional panel before footer. Left: headline + secondary CTA button. Right: large illustration element spanning ~40-45% of section width. Bottom edge uses organic wave SVG divider into footer.
Full-bleed dark footer 1440x565px. Five equal-width columns: logo/brand, Product links, Company links, Contact links, Support/CTA. Griting base layout.

layout._note: Section alternation between dark green (#003620 brand) and off-white is the primary rhythm driver — adapted from ellipsus full-bleed alternation pattern into griting's color scheme
